mapper.sql: id, title, content, writer, view_count, notice, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM post WHERE notice = true ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM post WHERE notice = false ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (title, content, writer, view_count, notice, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, 0, #{notice}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, notice = #{notice}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE id = #{id}
